description: 7. Video-service rankings over time - Bump chart

explanations.READ_ME: These are explanatory notes, not rendering instructions. Search WHAT or WHY. The chart code follows below.
explanations.WHAT: Bump chart: each service's line follows its rank through the years.
explanations.WHY: Rank makes changes in relative popularity easy to follow; direct endpoint labels identify services.
explanations.data_preparation_and_limits: The window/rank transform computes rankings within each year. Ranking is not normalisation and does not show the size of percentage gaps.

data.WHAT: Load a table, geographic file or inline records.
data.WHY: Keep source measurements separate from the instructions that draw them.

parse.WHAT: Read the listed CSV columns as numbers.
parse.WHY: Numerical comparisons and calculations must not treat values as text.

mark.WHAT: Choose the graphical shape: rectangle, line, point, text, rule, tick, bar or geoshape.
mark.WHY: The mark should support the comparison this chart is designed to show.

encoding.WHAT: Map data fields to position, colour, size, text and other visual properties.
encoding.WHY: The viewer needs a consistent visual meaning for each measurement or category.

layer.WHAT: Draw several sets of marks in the same plot.
layer.WHY: This combines data marks with labels, reference ticks and explanatory annotations.

field.WHAT: Read a named column from each data row.
field.WHY: This connects the source data or a derived field to the visual property.

domain.WHAT: Set the input bounds or categories of a scale.
domain.WHY: This controls the display mapping; a domain of 0-100 does NOT normalise the data.

range.WHAT: Set the visual outputs of a scale, such as colours or symbol sizes.
range.WHY: The domain's values need corresponding visual appearances.

tooltip.WHAT: List the fields shown when pointing at a mark.
tooltip.WHY: Exact values and context are available without permanently crowding the plot.

sort.WHAT: Set an explicit category or calculation order.
sort.WHY: Ages, services and years should not depend on accidental file order.

condition.WHAT: Use one visual setting when a test is true and another otherwise.
condition.WHY: This provides highlighting, readable text contrast and responsive annotations without changing measurements.

params.WHAT: Store adjustable values such as videoFormat or hoveredSeries.
params.WHY: Controls and JavaScript can update the view without modifying the CSV.

bind.WHAT: Connect a parameter to an input, such as a select dropdown.
bind.WHY: Readers can choose a format, series or city without editing code.

filter.WHAT: Keep only rows whose expression is true; datum means the current row.
filter.WHY: The selected format or annotation needs a subset of the data, not a change to its values.

window.WHAT: Calculate ranks or row numbers across sorted rows.
window.WHY: Rank compares services within each year; row_number selects an observation for a callout. Neither is normalisation.

groupby.WHAT: Run the calculation separately for each group.
groupby.WHY: Yearly service ranks must compare services within the same year.

format.WHAT: Choose file parsing or numeric display formatting, depending on its location.
format.WHY: For labels, .0f shows whole numbers and .1f one decimal; this does not replace the stored value.

config.WHAT: Set shared fonts, axes, legends and background styling.
config.WHY: Consistent presentation keeps attention on the data rather than unnecessary decoration.

explanations.interaction_bridge: bind creates chart dropdowns. assets/main.js handles custom hover/click events and updates Vega signals; conditions then change appearance. The page's state selector is HTML/JavaScript; the ocean-and-amber theme is fixed.

layer.description: WHAT: Connect each service's yearly ranks. WHY: The path shows whether the service moved up or down relative to the others.
WHAT: Label services at the final year. WHY: Direct labels reduce repeated trips between a line and its legend.
